name: QuickSwap Market
rootCause: QuickSwap's Market.xyz lending pool on Polygon was exploited on 24 October 2022 via a flash loan and Curve LP oracle manipulation. The attacker distorted collateral prices to borrow more funds, resulting in losses around $220,000. The incident led QuickSwap to close its lending service. The Curve LP oracle used by Market.xyz was vulnerable to read-only reentrancy in the get_virtual_price() function. Removing liquidity triggered contract fallback logic before pool balances updated, allowing the attacker to inflate the reported LP price and borrow undercollateralized funds.

descriptions.text: QuickSwap's Market.xyz lending pool on Polygon was exploited on 24 October 2022 via a flash loan and Curve LP oracle manipulation. The attacker distorted collateral prices to borrow more funds, resulting in losses around $220,000. The incident led QuickSwap to close its lending service. The Curve LP oracle used by Market.xyz was vulnerable to read-only reentrancy in the get_virtual_price() function. Removing liquidity triggered contract fallback logic before pool balances updated, allowing the attacker to inflate the reported LP price and borrow undercollateralized funds.

Adding to the recent string of oracle manipulation attacks is an attack on the miMATIC ($MAI) market on the QuickSwap decentralized exchange. An exploiter was able to manipulate the spot price of assets to borrow funds, ultimately making off with 138 ETH ($188,000) that they mixed through Tornado Cash. The vulnerability was due to the use of a Curve LP oracle, which contains a vulnerability that was disclosed by a security firm earlier that month. Security firm PeckShield initially suggested the issue might have been with QiDAO, which creates the $MAI stablecoin .
